incidents.name: NovaX stake/withdraw valuation sandwich
incidents.notes: TokenStake.stake() records the deposit as a USDT value at the pair's live rate and withdraw() pays it back out in tokens at the rate then, so the attacker staked, dumped the pool inside a flash swap and withdrew far more NovaXM2E.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x55C9EEbd368873494C7d06A4900E8F5674B11bD2 created 2024-06-13T15:42:04Z by 0x1d874e61a930c017b6f98ca36665b2587318ab07, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x81ca56b6973ff63e3ff2b3f99cb6a6d211269e79; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
